listResponse.identityUnverified: boolean; blocks automatic TOFU and management; an explicit native reauthorization may start a new claim
listResponse.authorization: verified HostStatus or null: mode, claim, env, generation and host key id
listResponse.claimPending: boolean; this native Client has an unfinished claim that can be resumed

claimRequest.hostId: non-empty string; endpoint resolved from native LAN discovery
claimRequest.claimToken: optional string from a completed Bluetooth setup; forwarded to the Host claim unchanged
claimRequest.recoverIdentity: optional boolean, default false; only an explicit user reauthorization may replace this account’s old Host key; never enable for background/Bluetooth automatic claim
claimRequest.scopeId: optional selected Space id; required for Space Hosts. Cloud derives the tenant from the authenticated user and checks ownership.

claimResponse.claimed: true only after Host persistence and cloud receipt commit; false when explicit identity recovery submitted an administrator application awaiting approval/confirmation
claimResponse.application: present for explicit recovery on an already claimed Admin Host; the Host administrator request result. The App confirms an approved receipt through /app/host/authorization before treating it as claimed
claimResponse.identityConflict: HOST_IDENTITY_CHANGED requires explicit native LAN reauthorization. A new locally confirmed pin and unfinished-confirmation marker persist before submitting the mutation; retries remain bound to that pin. The cloud directory changes only after a Host approval receipt
